cases.name: Carol Rofstad
cases.about: She was a student at Illinois State University.
cases.narrative: She was found beaten unconscious outside of her Delta Zeta sorority house, then located at 602 S. Fell St. She was discovered around noon, about 12 hours after the attack, taken to the hospital and died the next day. A railroad tie was found near her body and suspected to be the murder weapon.

cases.name: Amy E. Moore
cases.about: Grove Elementary School Principal Sarah Edwards said Amy Moore was an “an outstanding mother, daughter, educator, and friend.” “A graduate of Unit 5 Schools, Amy was a gifted educator who impacted the lives of thousands of students,” Edwards wrote in a statement. “She was a beloved second-grade teacher at Grove Elementary for almost 20 years, and lived her life to serve others, especially her three children.”
